### Improvements

- Dragging files onto the tree to move them keeps your place in the file list or gallery, so you can carry on moving files from further down without scrolling back each time.

No agent, embedding service or Pro update needed for this release.

### Bug fixes

- Selecting a folder or location shows the Slideshow and Playlist buttons again when its files include images or videos. 1.4.14 stopped showing them.
- The Slideshow button on a selected image no longer disappears when the details panel refreshes.

No agent, embedding service or Pro update needed for this release.

### Security

- **Names are always shown as plain text.** A file, folder, location or tag name containing HTML markup, which Linux and macOS allow in file names, could run code in the browser of anyone who saw it in File Hunter. Names, paths, tags, descriptions and messages are now always shown as text. Every earlier version is affected, so upgrading is recommended.

### New features

- **Select files from the keyboard with S.** With one or more files selected, pressing S selects or deselects the file you're on, and the arrow keys then move through the list without changing the selection, so you can pick out files one by one without Ctrl/Cmd-clicking. The file you're on is highlighted the same way as when the mouse hovers over it. Shift+Up/Down moves and adds the file it lands on. Press Escape or click in the list to stop; the selection is kept. ### New features

- **Links and browser history.** The address bar now follows where you are: selecting a location or folder puts its path in the URL, e.g. `#/Local%20Agent/Photos/2024`. The browser's Back and Forward buttons move between the locations and folders you've visited, and opening a URL with a path goes straight to that folder, so folders can be bookmarked and shared with other users. A link to a folder that has since been renamed, moved or deleted opens the dashboard.

### Bug fixes

- **"Search within" no longer fails on large folders.** In 1.4.10, searching within a folder containing more than about 16,000 embedded images (or documents) failed with a server error. Large folders are now searched in batches, and the results are exactly the same as for a small folder: the best matches in the whole folder.
- **Gallery view shows an icon for images that can't be displayed, instead of a broken image.** This now works everywhere the gallery is used, including search results an

### New features

- **Full text document search.** The content search panel has a new mode dropdown: **Semantic** (search by meaning, as before) or **Full text** (search for exact words). In Full text mode every word must appear, `"quoted phrases"` match exactly, `word*` matches the start of a word, and `-word` leaves out documents containing it. Case and accents are ignored, and document headings are searched too. Results are ranked by relevance.

### Improvements

- The "Similarity Search" section in Settings is now called **Embedding Service**, and its checkbox is "Enable embedding service". The embedding service powers more than image similarity search, and the hint now lists everything it turns on: image similarity search, document content search and Extract to Markdown. Your existing settings are kept.

No agent or embedding service update needed for this release.

### New features

- **Extract to Markdown.** When document search is enabled, documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument) have an "Extract to Markdown" button in the detail panel. The document's full text, with headings and tables, is saved as a markdown file next to the original and added to the catalogue. If a file with that name already exists, the new one is numbered, e.g. `report (2).md`. Extractions run one at a time alongside embedding scans, so they don't compete for the embedding service
- `reclassify.py` has moved to the `scripts/` folder and reads the database path from `config.json`, like the server.
